info.name: Histae API Rust
info.description: Collection generated from docs/http-contract.md (103 routes). Import it into Postman, set baseUrl to http://SERVER_IP:API_PORT for local network access, then fill in the variables. Mobile flow: OTP send, OTP verify, consents, profile. OTP verify and refresh responses populate accessToken and refreshToken. Admin sessions use adminCookie (full value “name=value”) and adminOrigin; a real WebAuthn proof is required to sign in. Webhooks require valid signatures. Requests marked ⚠️ have real effects: do not run the entire collection with Collection Runner. Do not export the collection after testing if it contains tokens. Detailed contract: docs/http-contract.md.
